rows.grounds: compound describing the nectar as the true nature of Kaula
imperative command addressed to the listener
compound qualifying the essence as consisting of Kāmakalā

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the Kaula nectar that is to be heard?
premises: The nectar is identified as the true essence of Kaula.
This Kaula essence is described as having the nature of Kāmakalā.
The listener is directly commanded to hear this teaching.
items.inference: The supreme Kaula nectar to be realized is essentially Kāmakalā.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal nuance of kāmakalā in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true essence of Kaula, whose very nature is Kāmakalā.
